runtime_rule: Transaction -> Receipt -> Trace / Token Transfer -> Final Execution State must be bound by transaction_hash.
be_implementation_requirements: transaction hash based token transfer resolver

decision_semantics.receipt_missing: Do not finalize execution success; route to existing review/pending/reconciliation semantics.
decision_semantics.receipt_status_1: Execution success evidence, not sufficient alone for total asset movement reconstruction.
decision_semantics.token_transfer_present: Asset movement evidence even when transaction_value is zero.
decision_semantics.internal_eth_movement: Asset movement evidence even when transaction_value is zero and token transfer is absent.
decision_semantics.no_value_movement_detected: No additional movement detected in DA-03 evidence scope; not proof that all possible asset movement is impossible.

out_of_scope: Ethereum-wide population rate inference from the 3,452 transaction DA-03 analysis population
